reviews.author: Trisha Honeycutt
reviews.text: I chose E.M. Auto Repair through a recommendation that they were fair and a trustworthy auto place in Spartanburg. I can genuinely say that they are very fair and trustworthy and operate with integrity. I went today there for an oil change and had him look over my VW Beatle. Eli was wonderful! He was informative and fair on the pricing. As a woman, I felt safe to know I have a place to take my car - if it needs repairs. He also recommended local tire places in the area. I highly recommend E.M. Auto. They went above and beyond. I felt safe. I was educated about my vehicle. I left feeling.good. Support local!

reviews.author: David Swank
reviews.text: They did a great job repairing my car. My main mechanic could not fix and referred me here. They did a great job communicating the issue and what was needed to fix. Their pricing was also very reasonable. Would recommend them to all.

reviews.author: Ava Meade
reviews.text: This shop is definitely the place to go the hours this man put into my car to try and fix it after I bought a lemon and broke down out of town in Spartanburg is insane!!! And he literally only charged me a few hundred dollars!!!! Eli is a stand up guy and he won't lie to you or steer you wrong!!!! I would recommend this shop a thousand times over and if I lived anywhere near here and not 4hrs away my car would be here for every oil change or issue!!!! If your looking for an honest mechanic look no further you found him!!!!!

reviews.author: Maya Nursari (Mrs. Drake)
reviews.text: Update! Was back to fix some noise the car was making. Only trust these guys to do the job. Noise fixed and it’s been over month and no more noise. My sweetie running good and feels much better. Excellent service and will be coming again for more!

reviews.author: Shelby Pitts
reviews.text: Got my car back up and running in no time! Diagnosed the problem and repaired it in a timely manner. They are very quick over the phone, and they have very fair and reasonable prices. Will be returning if something ever happens with my car again!

reviews.author: Noah Nespoli
reviews.text: I have been working with these guys for many years. They have taken care of my ‘16 STi on multiple occasions, from simple fixes and advice to full on engine block replacement. These guys are honest, reliable and friendly! Their work is always very professional and in my opinion superior to any other auto shops around. I 100% recommend to anyone who wants a true mechanic with knowledge and experience and quality customer service. Thanks guys!

reviews.author: Denise McAbee
reviews.text: Last week, I took my 2021 Honda Pilot in for 100K maintenance (timing belt, spark plugs, water pump, air filter etc) Eli was very professional, nice and got the job completed in the time frame he mentioned. My husband and I were both pleased with our entire experience there. Thanks Eli, keep up the good work !

reviews.author: Slade Smith
reviews.text: I was referred to Eli by a coworker, who swore by him, he did not disappoint. He took my Mercedes-Benz with all kind of issues and made her per like a kitten. My car is performing and it’s peak optimum with zero concerns. I think his pricing was more than fair and he did all the work in less than two days and it was a big job. I would recommend these guys 100% to anyone.

reviews.author: Cynthia Moss
reviews.text: We took our car here because it had a hesitation in it. Eli checked out vehicle and determined what was wrong with it. Did really good work and was not as costly as we were expecting. Eli was wonderful to work with . Very clear on costs and issues. Very thorough and so very nice! Def will be using them for any future repairs

reviews.author: Arthur Gill
reviews.text: Fantastic mechanic Eli is awesome he really knows his stuff when it comes European automobiles ,highly reccomended.

reviews.author: Angelica Nava
reviews.text: Jared was amazing throughout the whole repair process! I work for insurance and was helping a customer with finding a repair shop that could do repairs for wiring. Dealership was trying to overcharge for repairs. Jared was very efficient and helpful throughout the entire thing. Thank you so much for helping!

reviews.author: alexey trivol
reviews.text: Eli and his team are the best in town! I and all my family have taken our vehicles to EM Auto. I left a 5-star because they truly strive and show the best work on your vehicle always met my expectations and after I picked up my vehicle I left his shop satisfied. Will continue taking my vehicles to them!

reviews.author: Christopher Ruppe
reviews.text: These guys did a great job servicing the shaky braking on my Honda Accord. The vehicle and brakes were smooth and functioning perfectly again after EM made the repairs. Like New! They also evaluated the condition of the braking system when I took the car. They made the appropriate repairs without trying to upsell me on additional unnecessary parts and service. I will take my vehicle back to these guys if I ever need automotive work.

reviews.author: alex moreno
reviews.text: After taking to my vehicle to a few different mechanics and very unsatisfied with the repairs, my husband and I were about to give up fixing it. When a co-worker recommended EM auto I had my doubts, but we sure glad we did decided to give them a try. I am Extremely Happy with the repairs that was done on my vehicle. And the service was great. They guarantee their work and that was definitely important to us! We are relieved that we have found reliable mechanics which are hard to find!!

reviews.author: Erik Oiseaux
reviews.text: EM Auto is the Best! They service our Ram Truck and BMW. They don't try to sell you something that you don't need and their pricing is just right. They are kind, reliable and quick! I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Brenda Tate
reviews.text: I highly recommend EM Auto! We were recently first time customers and they repaired our 2013 Honda for a front wheel bearing issue.. Quick reliable, and honest service with a fair price. Our new number one go to for auto repair!

reviews.author: Harry Kenya
reviews.text: The Mechanic experience doesn't get any better than this place. Eli and his team is very professional! He gets his work done well, quickly, and an honest fair price. I've had him work on my cars many times, and he's never once disappointed. From oil changes, to replacing clutches, A/C work, transmission work, etc etc. Keep up the AMAZING work!!

reviews.author: Peggy OConnor
reviews.text: While they're clearly popular for a reason, I'm adding my voice to the chorus. Even though they're already busy, they made me and my 2008 LR2 Land Rover / dog truck feel like a priority. Plus, the team is as skilled as they are good-looking! "What more could you ask for?" Thank you very much!

reviews.author: Bule_ prep
reviews.text: Eli and Jacob do a fantastic job! Timely service, communicative and honest. Priced VERY well and did I say honest. In today's society its hard to find honest mechanics who are interested more in foxing cars rather then the money. These guys love their job and the the whole garage team is friendly. My wife bought a used car and we'll be back to them soon.

reviews.author: Shelby Donato
reviews.text: The kindest souls! No matter how many cars are on the lot, they will make sure to run a diagnostic within the same hour and begin to work on it asap. This is my third time taking my car to Eli, and every time I am thankful they can squeeze me in, and get the job done quickly and affordable. They make sure even after to fallow up and make sure everything is running smoothly. I cannot recommend this guys enough!

reviews.author: Yuri Prihodko
reviews.text: I had an engine and transmission replaced on a cargo van, along with several other maintenance services, and I was very impressed by the quality and professionalism at this shop. Prices were very reasonable, their schedule was flexible, and Eli was very thorough in making sure that everything that needed to be done was done right. When all was said and done, the van drove like new and I stayed within my budget. I will definitely be coming back for future maintenance and repairs.

reviews.author: Vlad Stanislav
reviews.text: Number 1 shop since day one. Eli and his brother are a great team. The employees are awesome! Best turn around time. Up front, honest, reliable, and very savvy when it comes to electronics/diagnostics! This shop is a true meaning of small local business. The best. No job he couldn’t do for me.

reviews.author: Cody Cole
reviews.text: I had a great experience at EM Auto and my Acura was taken care of in a professional manner the entire time. My oil change was extremely quick and the process was rather efficient. I have known the owner Eli and his brother Jacob for years and they will continue to give quality service for years to come. No better place to take your vehicle!

reviews.author: bruce alexander
reviews.text: This outfit is top notch. Eli and his team has performed a couple of major repairs for my old Audi and the work was done very well at a very reasonable price. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Todd Gack
reviews.text: Recomended from a friend, we took our 2013 Honda Civic to Eli and he diagnosed the front left wheel bearing within 1 hour. He gave us a fair price on the install and the service was complete the same day. Thank God we got the third assesment quote from Eli as we initially got a diagnose on our first assement of a faulty transmission and was referred to a transmission specialist/company where they wanted to replace the transmission. Wow, we almost traded in the car thinking a transmission replacement was too expensive. Folks, be careful out there. . We are thankful for the honesty from Eli at EM Auto. We will continue to take our business to Eli!

reviews.author: Beverly Rowland
reviews.text: The best recommendation I experience in quiet a while, this one is a keeper for sure. I finally have a team that is more than willing to work with me in keeping my vehicles running accurately and safe. The way they address my concerns, pin point the issue, explaining what it is, why, and how it would be corrected. This assures me that my cars are in good hands. Get this! what I really appreciate is Eli gives me heads up about other issues down the road, how long it will take to resolve the issue, a good day and time to get in and out. Eli and his team are by the book, great quality service, fair price and friendly environment. As long as I have my Lexus and very old BMW on the road, they will be service by E.M. Auto. Thank you so much for being REAL

reviews.author: Harold Wolff
reviews.text: Excellent experience. I chose to have my repair work done here because of their high reviews. My brakes were rubbing metal on metal. I had to wait for my vehicle to be repaired. Eli and the guys were able to obtain rotors and pads and get them replaced quickly and at a very reasonable price. Fast friendly high quality service is easy to recommend.

reviews.author: Johnny Parker
reviews.text: Had to have new drive shaft and of course new carrier bearing/ universal joints. I was shocked at how fast they had it fixed and the quality of the work was excellent. The price was reasonable for the size of the repairs done. I highly recommend these guys and would definitely use their services again.

reviews.author: Thomas Simmons
reviews.text: I had a very serious issue with my 2008 Volvo that might have resulted in it being scrapped. But Eli and his crew were able to identify and solve the issues at a reasonable rate and backed by a firm warranty on their work. Further, Eli checks up on clients afterwards to make sure the work is holding. I have not heard of any other mechanics doing this. Working with EM Auto has bought my vehicle several more years of life and I strongly recommend them for anyone that needs a major repair done on an imported vehicle.

reviews.author: Barbara Satchell
reviews.text: Eli worked on my car the day I called and didn't wait long until he gave me an estimate and what was wrong with the air conditioning. Fixed the air right away.. Very affordable and efficient in their work. Called the next day to see how it was running. Good mechanics.

reviews.author: Morgan Koepke
reviews.text: These guys out at E.M. Auto are amazing and can take care of your ride!! Super glad I got referred to them!! My 2013 Kia Optima SX (Daisy) check engine light come on and lost a lot of power. I dropped my car off on a Friday and they had it diagnosed and fixed by the next Tuesday!!! My car needed the turbo actuator replaced. They also fixed my driver window switch that hasn’t worked properly in years!! Fast, professional, and great service! Also it didn’t cost an arm or leg!! I cannot thank this shop enough && highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Teresa Williams
reviews.text: This guy told me it would take 15 hrs to remove the motor from a Toyota. That wasn't the time to repair according to him just to remove. Anyone knows that's not true. Then he didn't have enough respect for a potential customer to even call me back with the price to fix my car. Will not be returning here

reviews.author: Courtney Caddell
reviews.text: E M Auto is by far the best. Eli was honest, thorough, and reasonably priced. He did a head gasket job on my 04 4Runner that most shops would not even do because of how big of a job it is. He made sure that everything was working correctly and replaced anything that needed it. When asked questions, him and his brother both took their time to explain everything to me in great detail. They truly care about their customers. I am extremely thankful to have found them and will be using them from this point forward!

reviews.author: Ali Hill
reviews.text: E.M. Auto is the only place I will take my Durango- I immediately knew that this shop was a place of honesty and integrity. Any time a mechanic says "It needs xyz...but it doesn't need it right now- but you probably need to start planning ahead" I know that they aren't trying to sucker me into doing something that is just going to pad their wallet. They've done extensive work (8hr+ job) and were extremely fair in pricing. Cannot say enough good things about this shop!

reviews.author: Denys Dydnyk
reviews.text: I have Dodge pro master 3500 have crack flaxplate , couple shops don’t want so so that job because it’s take a lot of time and they probably did it know how to do. One person recommended me this shop, the stay behind they words , fixed at 2 days how they says. This is work van and I need that back to keep going, will recommend to all my friends. Again and again , you guys are awesome. God bless you and your business. Thanks again.

reviews.author: Crystal Mitchell
reviews.text: This is the second time I have used EM Auto! The first time was for an engine replacement which they did an amazing job on. Recently, my air was acting up and I was able to have my car back and fixed within 24 hours! I highly recommend them and will definitely use them again for any of my auto needs!

reviews.author: Andy Sawyer
reviews.text: I would give 10 stars if I could. Absolutely the best mechanic in the upstate hands down. Had 5 different mechanic shops try and diagnose a issue with my Jeep with no success. Elias diagnosed and fixed my fuel pump in a very timely and painless process. Professionalism, honesty, integrity and quality. That is just some of the standards that I witnessed. EM Auto is the only shop that will ever look under the hood of any of my vehicles again. Thanks for the job you done.

reviews.author: Temeka Smith
reviews.text: Great customer service and so far, my concern is corrected. They saved me money that I would have wasted going through the dealership! Highly recommend & will be taking my vehicles here from now on. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Spartan Enterprises
reviews.text: Eli and his team are amazing. I appreciate the ability to communicate the status of the situation openly and honestly. Then, the best part, is he was able to fulfill what was needed under budget! Great work and will use again for any mechanical issues. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: BRIAN Walsh
reviews.text: Outstanding as always thank you guys very much. It is the first time I have seen all lights off on dash. And prices were reasonable for all that we had fixed. And most of all my wife is happy. Happy wife happy life. Thanks Eli for your honesty and being straight-forward with repairs and cost. It’s nice to work with someone honest. We will be back for any other repairs we need.

reviews.author: mike stutzman
reviews.text: If you want a honest shop that will give you top quality service at a very reasonable rate, you need to bring your vehicle to EM Auto. Personally owned business takes pride in getting you the finest care at honest prices. Dont wast time with corporate chain repair shops that will try talking you into a bunch of repairs you just don't need and take days to complete. Great people saved the day for me and got me back on the road to continue enjoying my cross country vacation. HUGE THANKS!!

reviews.author: Jason Hines
reviews.text: I’ve taken two cars to them to have work done. One was a turbo replacement and the other was basically a rebuild. Both times they did incredible work. They’re professional, knowledgeable, and timely. I HIGHLY recommend using E.M. Auto! 10/10

reviews.author: stephen wagner
reviews.text: E M Auto took care of our mechanical issues correctly and quickly for us, and that means a lot when we depend on our trucks daily to make a living. I highly recommend E M Auto for any vehicle mechanical repairs.

reviews.author: Jamie Puckett
reviews.text: I have a 2010 Mercedes E63 that abruptly started misfiring so I took it to a shop in Spartanburg, one of the shops with coffee makers, leather sofas, a pretty receptionist, and all the claims of being a European auto repair shop. They kept my car two days and called me recommending that I take it to the Mercedes dealership but could not elaborate a true reason why. I called Mercedes of Greenville, who will not work on a Mercedes 10 years old unless it was purchased or always maintenance there. Mercedes of Asheville was a month wait. I took a chance and called E.M. Auto as I had never heard of or used them before, explained the situation, and took it in. About a week later these guys found the problem (cam shaft adjuster) and repaired it. I had them go ahead and do some other things to the car as well (motor and transmission mounts, transmission service, plugs, valve cover gaskets) and now the car drives and feels better than it ever has. These guys did not rely on a machine to tell them what was broke, they dug into it and found it, and then repaired it. About a week later they reached out to make sure all was good. If you do not know, an E63 is a high performance machine that can be complicated. These guys proved to me that they are more than qualified and capable of diagnosing and repairing on even the most complex automobiles. Hopefully I will not need them again, but if I do, I will call them without any hesitation.

reviews.author: George Dervissis
reviews.text: The only mechanic I trust with my BMW & Mercedes. Thanks again for all your hard work and quick turn-around.

reviews.author: Mike Cole
reviews.text: I recently lost my go-to auto mechanic of 35 years to retirement. I was concerned about finding a new auto mechanic. Eli Mercer is the man I found and I feel so very fortunate to now call E.M. Auto and Eli Mercer my new go-to auto mechanic. My 4th visit and the work is outstanding, completed on time at a fair price. I highly recommend E.M. Auto and Eli Mercer for all your auto repair and maintenance requirements.

reviews.author: Willliam McDaniel
reviews.text: Over last few years EM Auto has done a few repairs on my cars. Eli and everyone there always does a great job fixing my Cars. The most recent job my 2012 Prius v had spark plugs and coil packs changed. The job was done the same day as dropped off. I will be bring my other cars in the future when they need maintenance or repairs. Thanks

reviews.author: Heather Bragg
reviews.text: I have been coming to this shop for awhile now. The guys that do mechanic work are very very knowledgeable. I can describe to them what my car is doing wrong over the phone and they can nail it to a"T"... the problem, although yes , they prefer you bring in, but this is how experienced they are. Very trustworthy, dependable, reasonable priced.

reviews.author: Cassie Henson
reviews.text: I couldn't have asked for better service! Cracked radiator two days before Christmas and I'm in a panic. They calmed me down, looked at it and told me in a way I could understand everything that needed to be done and exactly how much it would cost. They understood I was on a tight budget and worked with me-car is running beautifully now. Would definitely recommend to anyone and if I have car trouble again I know exactly where I'm going.

reviews.author: Steve Miller
reviews.text: We have had a couple of our vehicles repaired a few times for different things. I would not consider going anywhere else other than E.M. Auto. Great Service! Great Work! Great Price! Great People!!!

reviews.author: Fruitful Hill Ministries Jeff Dobbins
reviews.text: Eli and crew always take care of us. We have a Toyota van and Chevrolet trucks and he is great no matter the mfr. Great value and very trust worthy. Best in town.

reviews.author: Lori McCoy
reviews.text: After receiving a very high estimate from a dealership, I came to E. M. Auto for an estimate. Eli was polite, professional and accommodating to my schedule. I dropped the car off to be looked at and Eli called a short time later to tell me what he found, the necessary repairs and what it would cost. He made sure I was ok with everything before he proceeded, which I greatly appreciated. He gave me an upfront estimate on how long he thought it would take to get the repairs finished......and was spot on. Highly recommend E.M.Auto if your car is acting up. Honest, knowledgeable mechanics that won't overcharge you.

reviews.author: Emily Modrak
reviews.text: I am so happy that I was referred to EM Auto! Eli is nice, helpful, honest, and wonderful with communication. I will definitely use him again and will refer my friends to his business!

reviews.author: Denise Foster
reviews.text: Was recommended highly from a friend. They were super nice when I called and got me in as soon as I needed them. Did great work and job was above expectations! Totally would recommend.

reviews.author: Matthew Brown
reviews.text: I wouldn't let anyone else work on a vehicle I own. I have known Elias for many years and never have I met someone who takes more pride and quality in their work. From an oil change to engine swaps no one else will pay the attention to detail the way this shop does.

reviews.author: John Dreher
reviews.text: Extensive attention to detail, through work with updates as the job progresses. Ive had a bmw 750i since "17 and Eli is the only person who has worked on my car. Eli gives options also as good better and best lines of products for the vehicles.Recommended import shop as well as domestic vehicles.

reviews.author: Antonio Drusin
reviews.text: Brought the car in for a cylinder misfire. Elias at E.M. Auto was very professional, looked at the car and called us back by the time he promised. Fixed the car perfectly at a fair price and it was ready by time promised (actually over an hour early!). This has helped very much since we had to travel back home that very day. Great experience at E.M. Auto. Thank You!

reviews.author: Mack Lengel
reviews.text: Best prices I’ve found in the area! They communicated well throughout the process and they even checked in with me the week after to make sure my car was driving nice and all my needs had been meet. I will definitely be coming to them for any future repairs.

reviews.author: Peter Erikson
reviews.text: Every time I've done business here, I've been pleased with the price, pleased with the quality, and absolutely amazed at the speed / turn-around. Eli and his crew are awesome -- I don't take my vehicles anywhere else!

reviews.author: Christian Norman
reviews.text: E.M. Auto is by far the best mechanic shop around!! I have been going to them for years! They have worked on 2 BMWs for me!! Mechanics are always scared of foreign vehicles, not them. Eli, Jacob, and the others can work on ANYTHING!! I do mean ANYTHING! They are very friendly and explain everything step by step. They are quick and responsive to any questions you may have. If you need maintenance or work done, do yourself and your wallet a favor. Go see E.M. Auto!

reviews.author: Lee Ridgill
reviews.text: I have had them do work 2 times now. Once installing my alternator (which was done perfectly and quickly) and very affordable compared to other quotes and now I had a special request to upgrade my electrical with larger power and ground wires which they did flawlessly ! I would highly recommend them to anyone ! Great experience !!!!

reviews.author: Cole Gainey
reviews.text: Square dealing auto repair shops are few and far between. E.M. is one of those few. I recently took my Toyota Tundra to E.M. to address a coolant leak at the front of the engine. After doing a pressure test to confirm that the water pump was the source of the leak, Eli called back and quoted a very reasonable price to replace the water pump, (AISIN, Toyota genuine supplier) thermostat, and serpentine belt. Turnaround was very impressive, the truck was ready for pickup the next day. I will definitely be a return customer of E.M. Auto.

reviews.author: Brittany Clickenger
reviews.text: The service was good. I'll admit I would have liked a discount on the price since I had the door completely apart and it diagnosed that the for regulator was broke bc it was easily visible that was what was wrong. I just couldn't get my hands on the part in the time that they could, and then them have it fixed and my husband needed his car for work by then

reviews.author: Rick Ohara
reviews.text: I highly recommend E.M. Auto. I took my Mercedes in for routine maintenance. They performed the routine maintenance and found items, that my regular mechanic had missed over the past five years. I opted to have the motor mounts replaced. Car now rides like it did when it was new.

reviews.author: Deb Kromer
reviews.text: Jacob and Eli always come thru for me. My Mitsubishi Eclipse was overheating so badly I had to drive in the 109 degree weather with my heater on high to cool the engine. The fuzes all started frying. He found a cracked reservoir and replaced the thermostat and timing belt while it was disassembled. Changed fuzes and bulbs. Now, I have AC, radio, gauges and interior lights! I am so very pleased. Will always go back to their shop and recommend them to friends!! And! They followed up with me days later to be sure all was good and I was satisfied!

reviews.author: Trey Harris
reviews.text: I work in parts at a local car dealership so I deal with most of the garages in our area. The fact that I chose Eli, and the guy's to repair my girlfriend's vehicle should tell you all you need to know. They are professional, courteous, and get the repair done quickly.

reviews.author: Benji Feno
reviews.text: These guys did a great job repairing my AC on my Mercedes AMG. They were very fair in their pricing as well. I will be taking both of our Mercedes to this shop from now on.

reviews.author: Kerry Collins
reviews.text: Had a great experience, very professional. They take their work serious and are quick too get your vehicle back to you . I've used them twice and I'm very happy with their work

reviews.author: Jerry Walsh
reviews.text: Eli Mercer and his brothers are very good mechanics and do a great job. Ive had them work on several of my vehicles. From an oil change to tear it down and put it back together.

reviews.author: Velma Moorman
reviews.text: Went to E.M. Auto 4 months ago(3/30/20) for repairs after other shops could not get my truck running properly. Not only did they correct the problems, but they also checked in on me(7/27/20) to make sure my truck was still running fine. Now that's what I consider great customer service!

reviews.author: Larry Hart
reviews.text: The ac stopped working in my auto.The complete system was replaced by these guy's and works fantastic.Price was close to half of what most garages charge and received a 2 year warranty.Highly recommended for all auto needs.

reviews.author: Enreicika Huey
reviews.text: Eli and his team are very well educated and cost efficient. Whenever I have a concern or question with my vehicles I don’t have to think twice on who to call for accurate and timely professionals to put my mind at ease with my car concerns.

reviews.author: E “EMAC” Mac
reviews.text: Very professional and friendly service. The technician was very clear in explaining the problem and how to resolve it. This auto repair shop is one of the best I have ever used to take car of my vehicles.

reviews.author: Jimi Edwards
reviews.text: They rebuilt the top end of my motor. They did excellent work and at a good price. I would highly recommend them. I will definitely be using them for future car repairs!

reviews.author: Amanda Jones
reviews.text: We had a van we affectionately referred to as "Wigbuster" because the front end vibrated and beat you up so badly. Eli and his crew fixed Wigbuster for far less than the competition. It's like a new vehicle! We've had to rename it, LOL. Great mechanic, and great price. We've been a customer for a couple of years, and will continue to be!

reviews.author: Devon Smith
reviews.text: I use Amsoil in place of traditional motor oils and it’s nice when you have a good reputable company like E M Auto who will put those high-quality lubricants in your vehicle to help it run better. So thanks guys!

reviews.author: Kristy Wakester
reviews.text: We use these guys for not only for our vehicles but our kids vehicles as well, they always take the time to explain exactly what’s going on and are happy to answer any questions I may have. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Tori MacMillan
reviews.text: Great and friendly car place that cares about their customers and not just trying to make a buck. Car was fixed quickly and came back sounding like it did when we drove it off the lot.

reviews.author: Maksim Stanislavov
reviews.text: I take my vehicles to this shop frequently. They always give me good prices and take great care of my vehicle! Always resolve my issue and offer me the best solutions. Over all great shop and great workers!

reviews.author: Alexandria Florey
reviews.text: Eli is the best around! He always gets the job done correctly, in a timely fashion and communicates all information well. Highly recommend E&M Auto!

reviews.author: Shannon B
reviews.text: E.M. Auto is the first shop I have found in the area that treats me great. I think they are very trustworthy. Would definitly recommend.

reviews.author: Maria Cruz
reviews.text: Fast service! Customer service was awesome too. The A/C in my car wasn't working and they got it done the same day. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Trenton Landrum
